rationale.edition: All 23 changed files are under web/src/** (frontend components, views, and a shared OTable core composable). No path lives under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and there are no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo) in the paths or symbols, so this is a pure OSS frontend change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped: the trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no explicit opt-out label or 'skip' request), and the change alters user-facing pagination behavior in the web UI rather than being docs/CI/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the change reworks list pagination restoration across several list views. The user-visible behavior is that switching folders now resets the list to page 1 (instead of restoring the previous folder's page), and a stale 'page' in the URL that is past the end of the list clamps back to page 1 and drops the param. This is an observable UI state/URL change worth verifying in a real browser.
rationale.area: Dashboards: Dashboards.vue has the most complete, self-contained folder-switch behavior (resets currentPage to 1, drops the 'page' query param, keeps the 'folder' param) and there is an existing Dashboards Playwright area with folder-switching specs, making it the cleanest single surface to exercise the new restorePage/pagination-reset behavior end-to-end.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core is the closest existing matrix shard (actual_folder Dashboards) whose run_files already cover the Dashboards list UI (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard2.spec.js), so the new pagination spec joins that shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff: the only tests changed are Vitest unit specs under web/src/**/*.spec.ts (AlertList, OTable, Dashboards, SloListPagination, etc.), which are unit coverage, not Playwright E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/.
